# Bundled third-party files

Unmodified copies from npm, bundled because extensions may not load remote code.

| File | Package | Version |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tesseract.min.js`, `worker.min.js` | [tesseract.js](https://www.npmjs.com/package/tesseract.js) (`dist/`) | 5.1.1 |
| `core/tesseract-core-lstm.wasm.js`, `core/tesseract-core-simd-lstm.wasm.js` | [tesseract.js-core](https://www.npmjs.com/package/tesseract.js-core) | 5.1.1 |
| `lang/eng.traineddata.gz` | [@tesseract.js-data/eng](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@tesseract.js-data/eng) (`4.0.0_best_int/`) | 1.0.0 |

tesseract.js and tesseract.js-core are Apache-2.0 (LICENSE files next to them). @tesseract.js-data/eng is published under MIT; the language data itself comes from the Tesseract OCR project (Apache-2.0).
